svg.title: Heddle woven HD icon
svg.desc: Neutral-gray H and orange D with uniform 16-unit separation cuts. The D has a constant 72-unit ribbon width and a centered horizontal cut.
svg.metadata: Colors: neutral gray #858585; orange #E68000. D outer radius: 152; inner radius: 80; center: (312,216). H vertical stroke width: 80; horizontal stroke width: 64 (y=184..248). D ribbon width: 72 throughout. All cuts: 16 units. Center cut: y=208..224. D inner bottom: y=296, aligned to the lower edge of the shared H cut. H-to-D vertical separation: x=280..296. Crossbar-to-stem separation: x=184..200. All visible geometry is vertically symmetric about y=216 (canvas y=280). Coordinates above precede the common 64-unit vertical translation.
